omni_sb_mana_cost_0 = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_character_unit = {
				is_army = yes
				unit_location = { omni_harsh_nature_terrain_trigger = yes }
			}
		}
		multiply = 1.5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			any_character_unit = {
				is_army = yes
				unit_location = { omni_fertile_nature_terrain_trigger = yes }
			}
		}
		multiply = 0.85
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = magus_supreme_trait }
		multiply = 0.5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_trait = archmage_trait has_trait = grand_archmage_trait } }
		multiply = 0.6
	}
	# Disrupt Magic (Melodian T2): a disrupted caster pays 50% more.
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_modifier = omni_disrupt_magic_mod }
		multiply = 1.5
	}
}
